integrity: The claim is proved by exact Bell-pair factorization and Bell-projection identities. The bundled checker uses exact integer arithmetic and is corroborative; no finite numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the ideal Bob-to-Alice arbitrary two-qubit branch and the source's stated physical order \(A_2,A_3\). It does not deny teleportation up to a fixed wire relabelling, does not assess the opposite direction, and does not analyze noise or hardware performance.
title: Crossed Bell-pair wiring forces a fixed output SWAP
